title: ARTDECO: Toward High-Fidelity On-the-Fly Reconstruction with Hierarchical Gaussian Structure and Feed-Forward Guidance
claim: Our method produces high-fidelity, efficient reconstructions from casual input sequences across diverse indoor and outdoor scenes.
layout: 3 columns: input strip and large scene, then indoor and outdoor galleries; stats box
description: A wide gallery of reconstruction results with no method diagram. The left panel has a gray background. At top left is a camera icon and a label reading 'VRNeRF (KITCHEN)'. Next to them is a strip of input video frames from a kitchen, with an arrow underneath labeled 'monocular captures'. Below the strip is a large 3D reconstruction of the kitchen seen from above, with a dashed box listing TIME 27.1 s, PSNR 28.56 dB and MEM 32.99 MB. The middle column stacks two reconstructions on top of their source photos: an office with desks and shelves, and a building facade with a large letter Y. The right column shows a long street scene reconstruction with parked cars, blended into surrounding street photos. The eye goes first to the large kitchen render.
caption: ARTDECO delivers high-fidelity, interactive 3D reconstruction from monocular images, combining efficiency with robustness across indoor and outdoor scenes.
abstract: On-the-fly 3D reconstruction from monocular image sequences is a long-standing challenge in computer vision, critical for applications such as real-to-sim, AR/VR, and robotics. Existing methods face a major tradeoff: per-scene optimization yields high fidelity but is computationally expensive, whereas feed-forward foundation models enable real-time inference but struggle with accuracy and robustness. In this work, we propose ARTDECO, a unified framework that combines the efficiency of feed-forward models with the reliability of SLAM-based pipelines. ARTDECO uses 3D foundation models for pose estimation and point prediction, coupled with a Gaussian decoder that transforms multi-scale features into structured 3D Gaussians. To sustain both fidelity and efficiency at scale, we design a hierarchical Gaussian representation with a LoD-aware rendering strategy, which improves rendering fidelity while reducing redundancy. Experiments on eight diverse indoor and outdoor benchmarks show that ARTDECO delivers interactive performance comparable to SLAM, robustness similar to feed-forward systems, and reconstruction quality close to per-scene optimization, providing a practical path toward on-the-fly digitization of real-world environments with both accurate geometry and high visual fidelity. Project page: https://city-super.github.io/artdeco/
